Our Story

THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE FRUIT

Good fruit.
Considered judgement.

Chosen by people who know fruit. Three generations of wholesale judgement, brought to the everyday table.

Discover Everyday Fresh
↗
The fruit. The source. The care between.
IN THIS CHAPTER
01
It begins with knowing what to look for.
02
From source to selection.
03
Two ways to enjoy BAAGH.
04
Knowledge, shared.
01
It begins with knowing what to look for.

A good piece of fruit is more than its colour. The skin, weight, aroma and feel each tell part of the story. BAAGH brings that attention to the fruit we choose and the way we present it.

02
From source to selection.

Our brand journey follows the fruit from the orchard, through selection and careful handling, to the table. The thought is simple: make the care behind a choice easier to see.

03
Two ways to enjoy BAAGH.

Everyday Fresh is for the everyday table. Signature is for fruit chosen to be given. Each starts with the fruit; the occasion shapes the presentation.

Explore Signature ↗
04
Knowledge, shared.

Fruit Intelligence opens up the details: a mango’s flesh and stone, a mandarin’s peel and segments, an apple’s core, a pomegranate’s arils. Explore at your own pace, then return to the collection whenever you are ready.
